content: {"summary":"Card payments failed at about a quarter of the arrival rate on 2026-09-16 because only card-processor-proxy-01 was active, rejecting requests with CPX-W430 while card-processor-proxy-02 was missing due to a node maintenance operation, leading to token‑budget exhaustion and PAYAPI‑E1107 errors. The issue cleared when proxy‑02 returned.","likely_cause":"Missing card-processor-proxy-02 instance caused token‑budget limit on proxy‑01 to be exceeded, triggering CPX‑W430 rate‑limit rejections and payment failures.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Payments were failing at roughly a quarter of the arrival rate.","evidence_ids":["INC-0197#0"],"quote":"Card payments failing with `PAYAPI-E1107` at roughly a quarter of the arrival rate."},{"text":"Only proxy‑01 was rejecting with CPX‑W430; proxy‑02 was absent.","evidence_ids":["INC-0197#0"],"quote":"card-processor-proxy-01 rejects attempts with `CPX-W430`; card-processor-proxy-02 is absent from the logs."},{"text":"Proxy‑02 was evicted because its egress node was cordoned for a kernel update.","evidence_ids":["INC-0197#1"],"quote":"the egress node hosting card-processor-proxy-02 is cordoned, then emptied, ahead of a kernel update."},{"text":"Proxy‑01’s token budget (180 RPS) was insufficient for the 240 RPS arrival rate, causing ~60 failures per second.","evidence_ids":["INC-0197#2"],"quote":"One instance gets 180 tokens a second ... remaining 240 − 180 = 60 a second ... about 60 `PAYAPI-E1107` a second."},{"text":"When proxy‑02 came back online, CPX‑W430 disappeared and the error rate returned to normal.","evidence_ids":["INC-0197#3"],"quote":"card-processor-proxy-02 Running and taking traffic. `CPX-W430` gone."}],"next_checks":["Verify token‑budget (CPX_LOCAL_RPS) settings for each proxy instance.","Add an alert for CPX‑W430 occurring from a single proxy instance.","Ensure egress node maintenance is coordinated with team‑payments and avoids single‑instance scenarios.","Monitor proxy instance count and health during node cordons/reboots."]}
